
{{alias}}( arr, name[, mapping] )
    Converts an array of objects to a "tidy" data set.

    The function assumes that each object in the input array has the fields
    specified in a provided mapping object.

    Parameters
    ----------
    arr: ArrayLikeObject<Object>
        Input array.

    name: string
        Data set name.

    mapping: Object (optional)
        Object mapping existing field names to new field names.

    Returns
    -------
    out: DataSet
        Data set instance.

    Examples
    --------
    > var x = [ { 'a': 1, 'b': 2 }, { 'a': 3, 'b': 4 } ];
    > var m = { 'a': 'x', 'b': 'y' };
    > var out = {{alias}}( x, 'data', m )
    <DataSet>

    See Also
    --------
